authoritative_for: role contracts used by the repository baseline

truthfulness_contract.verified_runtime_definition: A capability is verified runtime only when it is directly available and proven callable in the active Trae environment.
truthfulness_contract.repository_contract_definition: A role contract stored in this repository is authoritative for process and state, but not proof of runtime-callable repo agents.
truthfulness_contract.current_environment_note: Repository-defined .trae/agents and repo role names are not asserted here as runtime-callable native agents unless a human verifies that behavior in the active Trae workspace.

chief_orchestrator.purpose: Own the end-to-end workflow, choose the next role, and stop for human approval at the required gate.
trigger: A new task is created
A prior role finishes and records outputs
A blocker or escalation event is added
forbidden_tools: claims about unverified native repo agents
success_criteria: Human approval is requested before release or destructive actions
chief_orchestrator.failure_behavior: Record the blocker, try a documented fallback path, and escalate when the contract cannot continue safely.
chief_orchestrator.escalation: Escalate to the human when no approved next role, no safe model route, or no safe recovery path remains.

implementation_classification.native_trae_verified_runtime: Only the top-level Trae session may be present; repository role mapping is still managed by this repo contract.
implementation_classification.workaround: JSON task state and scripts provide durable coordination and recovery.
implementation_classification.limitation: This file does not prove runtime-callable repository subagents.

planner_architect.purpose: Turn objectives into a concrete implementation plan, scope boundaries, and handoff-ready tasks.
trigger: A task enters research or planning
Chief requests architecture or sequencing
planner_architect.failure_behavior: Record missing information and return the task to chief_orchestrator for clarification or re-planning.
planner_architect.escalation: Escalate when the objective or constraints are contradictory or incomplete.

implementation_classification.native_trae_verified_runtime: Not verified as a repo-callable native subagent here.
implementation_classification.workaround: Planning can be represented through the tracked task-state JSON and docs.
implementation_classification.limitation: No runtime callability guarantee is implied by this role definition.

research_docs.purpose: Gather contextual facts, summarize repository evidence, and draft truthful operational documentation updates.
trigger: Research is needed before planning or implementation
Documentation updates are explicitly required
success_criteria: Facts are traceable to repository evidence
Documentation is truthful about runtime support
research_docs.failure_behavior: Record uncertainty as a limitation instead of implying unsupported behavior.
research_docs.escalation: Escalate when a required claim cannot be proven from the repository or active environment.

implementation_classification.native_trae_verified_runtime: Not verified as a repo-callable native subagent here.
implementation_classification.workaround: Repository docs and JSON state preserve research outcomes between sessions.
implementation_classification.limitation: This role cannot make unsupported claims about runtime agent support.

coder_implementer.purpose: Make the requested repository changes within scope and preserve current worktree intent.
trigger: An approved implementation step is ready
A review failure requires a precise fix
success_criteria: Error handling and documentation remain adequate
coder_implementer.failure_behavior: Stop at the first unsafe ambiguity, record it, and return control for clarification or review.
coder_implementer.escalation: Escalate when requested changes conflict with current worktree state or cannot be completed safely.

implementation_classification.native_trae_verified_runtime: Not verified as a repo-callable native subagent here.
implementation_classification.workaround: The repository uses scripts and task-state records to coordinate implementation state.
implementation_classification.limitation: This contract does not prove runtime execution through repo-defined agents.

code_reviewer.purpose: Perform read-only implementation review for correctness, maintainability, and obvious defects.
trigger: Implementation finishes
A re-review is required after fixes
success_criteria: Low-severity notes do not block completion
code_reviewer.failure_behavior: Return FAIL with exact required fixes instead of vague commentary.
code_reviewer.escalation: Escalate when review cannot be completed independently with the available evidence.

implementation_classification.native_trae_verified_runtime: Not verified as a repo-callable native subagent here.
implementation_classification.workaround: Review outcomes can be stored in JSON state even when native review agents are unavailable.
implementation_classification.limitation: A repo file or name alone is not proof of native review runtime support.

runtime_execution.fallback_behavior: If the verified runtime path is unavailable, run a second security-scoped CodeReviewer pass and disclose the fallback explicitly.
runtime_execution.enforcement_note: Read-only behavior is enforced by the code-reviewer runtime contract; do not claim repository-defined .trae/agents files are runtime-callable proof.

security_reviewer.purpose: Perform a focused security pass for obvious unsafe behavior, secrets exposure, and unsafe operational assumptions.
trigger: Implementation reaches security review
A change touches sensitive workflow or runtime assumptions
security_reviewer.failure_behavior: Return actionable security blockers and require implementation follow-up.
security_reviewer.escalation: Escalate when security posture depends on runtime capabilities that are not verified.

implementation_classification.native_trae_verified_runtime: Not verified as a repo-callable native subagent here.
implementation_classification.workaround: Security outcomes are tracked in task-state JSON and handoff events.
implementation_classification.limitation: Security review cannot certify unavailable runtime controls.

runtime_execution.invocation_path: chief_orchestrator -> qa_test_verifier contract -> built-in default under no-edit verification mode
runtime_execution.fallback_behavior: If the verified runtime path is unavailable, chief_orchestrator performs the same verification-only flow manually and discloses the fallback.
runtime_execution.enforcement_note: The no-edit rule for QA verification is prompt/policy enforced, not a hard per-role tool sandbox.

qa_test_verifier.purpose: Check that the requested workflow reached a truthful tested state and record what was or was not verified.
trigger: Review passes or implementation is ready for testing
A release gate needs verification evidence
qa_test_verifier.failure_behavior: Record unverified checks as gaps and route back for fixes or human decision.
qa_test_verifier.escalation: Escalate when required test evidence cannot be produced in the current environment.

implementation_classification.native_trae_verified_runtime: Not verified as a repo-callable native subagent here.
implementation_classification.workaround: QA evidence is preserved in the JSON task log even without native test-role execution.
implementation_classification.limitation: This role cannot convert missing evidence into a pass.

git_release_gatekeeper.purpose: Hold the release or handoff gate until review, security, QA, and human approval requirements are satisfied.
trigger: Task enters release or final approval gating
A human requests release readiness status
success_criteria: Gate decision is traceable to recorded evidence
git_release_gatekeeper.failure_behavior: Return no-go with the exact missing approval or verification item.
git_release_gatekeeper.escalation: Escalate to the human when policy requires a manual decision.

implementation_classification.native_trae_verified_runtime: Not verified as a repo-callable native subagent here.
implementation_classification.workaround: Gatekeeping is represented as repository state plus human approval checkpoints.
implementation_classification.limitation: This role does not itself perform native git or release operations.

task_state_coordinator.purpose: Keep the authoritative task-state JSON consistent, append events, and preserve recovery context between sessions.
trigger: A task is created
A phase changes
A model fallback, review result, or blocker must be recorded
task_state_coordinator.failure_behavior: Fail closed, keep the last valid JSON, and report the exact field or path problem.
task_state_coordinator.escalation: Escalate when the task record becomes ambiguous or cannot be updated safely.

implementation_classification.native_trae_verified_runtime: The repository scripts are tracked artifacts, not proof of native runtime role execution.
implementation_classification.workaround: This role is implemented through JSON templates and PowerShell scripts.
implementation_classification.limitation: State coordination is file-based and depends on explicit script use.

lightweight_routine.purpose: Handle low-risk structured routine tasks such as small summaries, rote updates, or lightweight routing support.
trigger: A routine low-risk action is requested
A faster low-cost fallback path is acceptable
outputs: escalation back to a heavier role when needed
success_criteria: Escalation happens when the task stops being routine
lightweight_routine.failure_behavior: Stop and hand off to chief_orchestrator or planner_architect when complexity increases.
lightweight_routine.escalation: Escalate when changes affect architecture, security, or release decisions.

implementation_classification.native_trae_verified_runtime: Not verified as a repo-callable native subagent here.
implementation_classification.workaround: Routine work can be represented through the same repo task-state system.
implementation_classification.limitation: This role is intentionally not a high-risk decision maker.
